title: Peraso rises 13.42% after hours following new module launch
summary: Peraso (PRSO) shares rose 13.42% in after-hours trading following the announcement of its new PRM2145 60 GHz mmWave module designed for defense and UAV applications. The product launch coincided with the company’s scheduled Q2 2026 earnings release after market close on August 11, 2026. The post Peraso rises 13.42% after hours following new module launch appeared first on Peraso .
